content_guidelines.sound_effects: Use native Web Audio API or simple HTML5 Audio. Create synth sounds for 'Correct' (High C-E-G chord) and 'Incorrect' (Low discordant) if external assets are missing.

universal_guidelines: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, click, load).
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute.
Do NOT use gradients for dark colors.
